# UNE Maritime MCP Gateway — EU Decarbonization & Compliance Engine
> Deterministic, sub-millisecond Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateway for European maritime environmental regulations: FuelEU Maritime (Regulation EU 2023/1805) and EU ETS Maritime (Directive EU 2023/959).

## Overview
UNE Maritime MCP delivers canonical, mathematically proven compliance evaluations, economic banking/borrowing arbitrations, and fleet pooling optimizations. Every response includes a deterministic state proof (SHA-256 `result_hash`, `attestation_id`, and cryptographic HMAC signature).

- **Production Endpoint:** https://maritime.une.education/mcp.php
- **Protocol:** MCP (2024-11-05) / JSON-RPC 2.0
- **Legal Authority:** Regulation (EU) 2023/1805, Directive (EU) 2023/959, Directive 2003/87/EC

## Tools & Capabilities

### lookup_fuel_wtw_emission_factor
- **Description:** Retrieves statutory Well-to-Wake (WtW), Well-to-Tank (WtT), Tank-to-Wake (TtW), and Lower Calorific Value (LCV) default parameters directly sourced from Regulation (EU) 2023/1805 Annex II.
- **Arguments:**
  - `fuel_type` (string, e.g. "VLSFO", "MGO", "LNG", "LPG", "HVO", "B100", "e-methanol", "e-ammonia")

### calculate_voyage_ghg_intensity
- **Description:** Aggregates multi-leg voyages, enforces port-to-scope consistency, and applies Article 2 geographical scope factors (50% on extra-EU inbound/outbound routes, 100% intra-EU) against statutory limits (89.3368 gCO₂eq/MJ baseline).
- **Arguments:**
  - `fuel_consumption_records` (array of consumption records per fuel type)
  - `voyage_scope` (enum: "INTRA_EU", "EXTRA_EU_INBOUND", "EXTRA_EU_OUTBOUND")

### calculate_fueleu_banking_borrowing
- **Description:** Solves compliance surplus banking and statutory compliance deficit borrowing under Article 20 (capped at 2% of statutory target, mandatory 1.1x repayment multiplier, 2-year consecutive borrowing limit).

### optimize_fueleu_pool_allocation
- **Description:** Pure mathematical solver for fleet and cross-company compliance pooling under Regulation (EU) 2023/1805 Article 21. Eliminates state financial penalties via optimal internal compliance balance transfers.

### calculate_fueleu_maritime_penalty
- **Description:** Computes exact statutory financial penalties under FuelEU Maritime Annex IV: `(deficit_gCO2eq / (actual_intensity * 41000)) * 2400 EUR`.

### calculate_maritime_ets_surrender
- **Description:** Calculates mandatory EU Allowance (EUA) surrender volume under EU ETS Maritime with phase-in rate logic (40% in 2024, 70% in 2025, 100% in 2026+).

### provision_free_api_key
- **Description:** Grants automated in-band sandbox access credentials for testing agents and developers.

## Inter-Node Ecosystem (UNE AtoA Network)
- **Technical Standards & Export Controls:** https://standards.une.education/mcp.php
- **Customs Valuation & TARIC:** https://customs.une.education/mcp.php
- **French Labor & Corporate Resolution:** https://france.une.education/mcp.php
